# Original M2 numerical reference

These five byte-exact project source files were selected from the verified
original training archive `runs/m2-stream-accuracy4096-s5/code`,catalogue
121fd05a2f75e30b0c738dac592c67c6d015aa6043a43e4032d91ac662de794b.
The full original source manifest is retained;the regression checks its catalogue
digest and each selected file before import. `.gitattributes` preserves bytes.

They are a test reference,not an alternative runtime or copied pretrained model.
Keeping the small source subset here lets a clean checkout execute the legacy
comparison without depending on private local run directories. No weights,
screenshots or third-party library sources are included.
